configuration_selection: Existing manuscript settings retained; all models retrained from scratch on four approved genotypes; checkpoint epochs selected with 48-h validation only.
mask_seed_rule: 20260910 + training seed; shared across the four reference models
physics: ordinary logistic with genotype-specific r and capacity; prefix-conditioned individual latent state; all 23 interior nodes
data_loss: mean per-plant masked RMSE on observed 0--36 h targets
input: genotype, available early lengths, their masks, and elapsed time; no explicit environmental input
